instruction: whats needed to get into bscs
output: For BS Computer Science you need FSc Pre-Engineering, ICS, or an equivalent qualification with at least 50 percent marks. If you studied Pre-Medical, you can still apply provided you have passed additional Mathematics. You will also need to sit the NUML entry test, which covers English, Mathematics, and analytical reasoning. Your final selection depends on a merit formula combining your previous results with your test score. Requirements are reviewed each year, so please confirm the current criteria with the Admissions Office before you apply.

instruction: how do i apply online at numl
output: You apply through NUML's official online admission system by first selecting your campus and admission type, then entering your basic details. Once registered, you'll receive an Application ID and password by email. Log back in with these to complete every section of the form - Basic Information, Residence, Academics, Guardians, and Additional Information - and upload scanned copies of your documents. Before submitting, you must tick the "I Accept" undertaking checkbox. Make sure everything is complete and submitted before the deadline, since incomplete or late applications are not entertained.

instruction: when do admissions open at numl islamabad
output: NUML runs two main admission intakes each year at the Islamabad campus, Fall and Spring, plus separate functional language courses that usually start around June. The exact opening and closing dates shift slightly every year, so rather than relying on a fixed date, check the admission calendar on the official NUML website closer to when you plan to apply. If you're unsure which session fits you, the Admissions Office can confirm the current schedule.

instruction: do i need to take a test to get into numl
output: Yes. Undergraduate admission at NUML depends on your previous academic results, NUML's own entry test, and an interview together. The test covers English, Mathematics, and analytical reasoning. If you already hold a valid NTS GAT-General score, you may be exempt from retaking NUML's general test, though the written or subjective portion may still be required depending on your faculty. Your final merit position combines your academic score with your entry test result, so both matter for your selection.

instruction: can i apply to more than one program at numl
output: Yes, up to three undergraduate programs, as long as they're all within the same faculty - you can do this with a single application ID and one processing fee, and your test and interview marks will count toward each program. If you want to apply to a program in a different faculty, though, you'll need to register a separate application ID and pay the processing fee again for that one. Keep this in mind when shortlisting programs across different faculties, since it costs more and takes extra steps.

instruction: i havent got my fsc result yet can i still apply
output: Yes, you can apply as a provisional candidate while your Intermediate (HSSC) result is still awaited, and you'll be allowed to sit the entry test and interview in the meantime. However, you must submit your final result within 7 days of the start of classes, or your provisional admission will be cancelled. Make sure you follow up quickly once your result is announced so you don't miss this deadline.

instruction: can i apply for ms with an awaited result
output: No. Provisional admission based on an awaited or web result is not accepted for MS, MPhil, PhD, MBA, BS Bridging, ADCP, or Functional Course programs at NUML. For these, you need to submit a final, signed degree or transcript at the time of your application - a provisional or online result printout won't be accepted, so make sure your degree is finalized before you apply

instruction: are there any quota seats at numl
output: Yes, NUML reserves certain seats under quota categories, including for students from Balochistan, differently-abled students, wards of Shuhada, wards of army personnel (processed through the W&R directorate only), and sports-based candidates. If you believe you qualify under one of these categories, check the specific documentation required for that quota and confirm the process with the Admissions Office, since each quota has its own requirements.

instruction: what percentage do i need in fsc to apply for bs programs
output: For most BS programs at NUML, you need FSc, ICS, I.Com, or FA with at least 45 percent marks, or an A-Level qualification with at least 50 percent marks. Some programs also prefer specific subjects at the intermediate level, such as Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Computer Science, or Commerce. Since exact requirements differ by program, check the eligibility page for the specific degree you're interested in before applying.

instruction: i didnt study math in fsc can i still apply for bscs
output: Yes, you can still apply, but if you're admitted without a Mathematics background at the intermediate level, you'll be required to complete a Mathematics deficiency course worth 6 credit hours within your first two semesters. This is meant to bring you up to the level needed for the program, so plan your course load accordingly in your first year.

instruction: is there a fee for the ms entry test
output: Yes. If you're shortlisted to appear in NUML's own GAT test for an MS, MPhil, or PhD program, you're required to deposit Rs. 1,200 as the GAT fee before sitting the test. This is separate from your regular admission processing fee, so make sure you budget for it once you're shortlisted.

instruction: im a foreign national how do i apply to numl
output: You'll need to complete the standard online application form like any other applicant, but you must also separately download and fill the "International Applicants" admission form, available under the Downloads section of the NUML website. Along with it, attach a recent passport-sized photograph, a copy of your passport, and your educational documents translated into English. Since requirements for international applicants can vary, it's a good idea to also reach out to the Admissions Office directly to confirm you have everything needed.

instruction: is numl degree recognized by hec
output: Yes, all degree programs offered at NUML are recognized by the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan through its respective councils. That said, eligibility criteria for individual programs can still vary, so it's worth double-checking the specific requirements for the program you're interested in rather than assuming they're all identical.

instruction: what happens if i lied on my numl application
output: Your admission can be cancelled at any stage, without any refund except the security fee, if you're later found ineligible according to the original advertisement, or if any degree or certificate you submitted turns out to be fake or unrecognized. Because of this, you should confirm your own eligibility carefully before processing your admission form online, rather than assuming it will go unnoticed.

instruction: how is the final merit list decided
output: Your admission to an undergraduate program at NUML is decided using a combination of three things - your entry test score, your previous academic qualification, and your interview marks - rather than any single one of these alone. This means doing well on just the test, or just your past results, isn't enough on its own; all three parts count toward your final position.

instruction: i have a gre score do i still need to take numls test
output: You may be exempted from NUML's own General Ability Test if you already hold a valid GRE International score or an NTS GAT-General score. However, you'll still be required to pass the written or subjective portion of NUML's GAT-General, scheduled separately by your faculty. So while the exemption saves you from one part of the test, it doesn't remove the requirement entirely.

instruction: i have a 2 year ba can i join bs directly
output: Yes. If you hold a two-year BA or BSc degree, you can be admitted directly into the third year, or fifth semester, of a four-year BS program at NUML. Before that happens, though, you'll need to successfully complete 15 to 18 credit hours of bridging courses prescribed by HEC and the university, which fill the gap between your two-year degree and the four-year program structure.

instruction: where do i actually apply online
output: NUML's online admission system is hosted on a separate site from the main NUML website, at onlineadmission.numl.edu.pk. This same portal is used for the Islamabad main campus as well as all the regional campuses, so make sure you select the correct campus and program once you're there.

instruction: what documents do i need to bring to my numl interview
output: You'll need to bring your original documents for verification, including your CNIC, academic certificates, degrees, and your GAT result where applicable. If you're a provisional applicant, or you applied to multiple programs, you'll be given separate interview slots, so check your admission portal carefully for your specific timing and don't assume one slot covers everything.

instruction: how long is the numl application window open
output: The application window for a given NUML intake is typically open for around one month, though the exact opening and closing dates are announced separately for each session. Don't assume the timeline is the same every year - always check the current admission calendar on the NUML website rather than going by a previous session's dates.

instruction: what score do i need to pass numls entry test
output: Generally, you need to score at least 50 percent in NUML's entry test to be considered for selection. That said, competitive programs with high demand can require a noticeably higher score to actually make it onto the final merit list, so treat 50 percent as a minimum, not a guarantee of a seat.

instruction: will there be more than one merit list
output: Yes, NUML typically publishes more than one merit list per admission cycle - usually a first, second, and sometimes a third list, released in sequence for both undergraduate and graduate programs. If you don't appear on the first list, you may still appear on a later one as seats open up, so keep checking the official NUML website instead of assuming the first list is final.

instruction: is there a quota for overseas pakistanis
output: Yes, NUML reserves a 5 percent admission quota for children of Overseas Pakistanis. You'll still need to meet the minimum eligibility criteria for your program and go through the same test and interview schedule as everyone else - this quota doesn't come with any fee concessions.

instruction: i have a sports certificate does that help my admission
output: It can. NUML offers limited undergraduate seats under a quota for candidates with provincial, national, or international certificates in areas like sports, debate, Qirat, Naat, poetry, calligraphy, singing, dramatics, and painting. You'll need to pay an additional processing fee of Rs. 1,000 under this quota. If you're selected specifically under the sports quota, you're awarded a scholarship covering a full fee waiver along with free hostel accommodation.

instruction: i already have a gre score for ms do i still need to test
output: Yes. Even with a qualifying HEC ETC, NTS, or GRE score, applicants to MBA, MS, MPhil, or PhD programs are still required to appear in NUML's own Subjective Test, worth 25 marks, according to the schedule set by their faculty. So an external score gets you past part of the process, but not the whole thing.

instruction: what documents does bba hons need at interview
output: For BS or BBA (Hons) programs specifically, you're required to bring IBCC-verified educational documents to your interview, on top of the standard identification and academic documents everyone else brings. It's worth getting this verification done ahead of time so you're not scrambling right before your interview slot.

instruction: im on the merit list am i admitted now
output: Not quite yet. Being on the merit list is an important step, but NUML only issues your official course fee voucher after your submitted documents and eligibility have been verified. You should treat the fee voucher and paying it by the deadline as what actually finalizes your admission, not the merit list alone - don't assume your seat is secured until you've completed this step.

instruction: what if i miss phase 1 admissions
output: You may still have a chance. NUML admissions for a given intake are often run in phases - Phase-I and Phase-II - each with its own separate deadline, entry test date, and merit list. If a Phase-II window is announced for that session, you can apply then, so check the NUML website to see if it's currently open.

instruction: how do i know if my class is morning or evening shift
output: Some NUML programs run in more than one shift, such as morning and evening sections, especially at the undergraduate level. You should check your admission portal to confirm exactly which shift you've been placed in, since this will affect your class timing going forward.

instruction: im on the merit list what do i do next
output: Getting onto the merit list isn't the last step. After you're selected, you'll still need to complete document and eligibility verification, get your official fee voucher, pay it before the stated deadline, and keep checking your admission portal for further enrollment and class-related updates. Treat this as an ongoing process rather than something that ends once your name appears on the list.

instruction: what fee do i pay when i first get admitted
output: When you're first admitted at NUML, you'll pay three one-time charges: an admission fee, a registration fee, and a refundable security fee. These are separate from your regular tuition and are paid only once, at the time you join. The exact amount depends on your program and academic level, so check the current semester's official fee structure for your specific figures.

instruction: what fees do i pay every semester
output: Every semester, you'll pay a set of recurring charges on top of your one-time admission charges. These typically include your tuition fee, examination fee, maintenance charges, and a library subscription fee, along with smaller heads like a magazine fund. The exact amount depends on your program, so check the semester-wise fee structure that applies to you rather than assuming a flat rate across all departments.

instruction: how do i pay my numl fee
output: You pay your NUML fee against a fee challan, which you can either collect from the university or download yourself from the NUML LMS or admission portal. Once you have it, you can pay at an NUML campus fee counter or at any bank branch supported by the payment system named on the challan. Make sure you pay before the due date printed on it, since paying late can add an extra late fee to what you owe.

instruction: can i get my money back if i leave numl after paying fee
output: It depends on how quickly you withdraw. If you claim a refund in writing within the first week after your semester starts, you get the full amount back. Within the second week, you get fifty percent back. After the fifteenth day of the semester, no refund is given. If you were admitted provisionally and your final result doesn't meet the required percentage, you can get a full refund by claiming it in writing within seven days of the result being announced.

instruction: what happens if i pay my challan late
output: Paying after the due date printed on your fee challan can result in an additional late fee being added on top of the original amount. This due date is specific to your own individual challan, so don't assume there's a standard grace period across the board - always check the exact date printed on yours.

instruction: where can i check the correct current fee amount
output: Tuition and other charges get revised and republished every semester, so the only reliable place to check your current fee amount is the official fee structure document on the NUML website, or the figure shown on your own generated challan. Avoid relying on older printed material or unofficial sources, since those amounts may no longer be accurate.

instruction: im an overseas pakistani is my fee the same
output: No. NUML's published fee structure applies to local Pakistani students only. If you're an Overseas Pakistani, hold foreign nationality, or are an international student, your fee structure is different and needs to be obtained directly from the University Admission Office rather than the standard published document.

instruction: if i freeze my semester do i still pay fee
output: You'll need to apply for approval through the Academics Branch first, rather than simply stopping attendance. How freezing affects fees you've already paid, or fees still due, can vary depending on your specific case. Because of this, confirm the exact financial impact with the Finance Branch at the time you apply, rather than assuming your fee is automatically waived or carried forward.

instruction: is there a fee for a bonafide certificate
output: Requests like a bonafide certificate, character certificate, or migration/NOC document go through prescribed proformas submitted to the Academics Branch, and some of these may carry a nominal processing charge. Since this isn't the same as your regular semester fee, confirm directly whether a charge applies when you submit your specific proforma.

instruction: my fee payment isnt showing up who do i contact
output: If you have a fee discrepancy, a challan issue, or a payment that isn't confirming through the LMS or admission portal, contact the Finance Branch directly rather than the Admissions Office. Fee collection and admission processing are handled by separate branches at NUML, so the Finance Branch is the right place to get this resolved.

instruction: which undergraduate programs are being offered at numl
output: numl offers undergraduate programs in multple faculties that includes computer science, software engineering, buisness administration, mass communication and foreign languages.uou can pursue the 4th years (eight semester) BS degrees structured under High education commission guidelines. These programs work with theory, general education requirements, lab work, and a final-year project. Admissions open twice a year during Fall and Spring semesters. For a full list of active degree offerings, you should contact the Academics Branch or check the university portal.

instruction: does numl offer morning and evening program for bs cs
output: Yes, NUML offers both Morning and Evening shifts for undergraduate computing degrees like BS Computer Science and BS Software Engineering. You will follow the exact same curriculum, complete equal credit hours, and take standard examinations even with your different shift time. Timetables, lecture schedules, and lab sessions are arranged separately for each shift. Your final degree certificate and transcript will not distinguish between morning and evening shifts. If you want to check shift seat availability, you must contact the Admissions Office.

instruction: what language courses or short diplomas i can apply for
output: You can apply for short functional language certificates, diploma programs, and advanced diplomas through the Faculty of Languages at NUML. Offerings include English, Chinese, Arabic, French, German, Korean, Japanese, and Persian. These courses run in 8-week, 16-week, or semester-long durations, focusing on practical speaking, reading, and writing skills. These programs run independently along with regular degree tracks and are open to both university students and external applicants. For functional language schedules, contact the Faculty of Languages.

instruction: what post graduate and mphil programs numl offer for high level studies
output: NUML offers Master of Science (MS), Master of Philosophy (MPhil), and PhD programs across several academic disciplines. You can apply in advanced research degrees in fields such as Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, English Linguistics, Management Sciences, and Education. Program completion requires passing graduate coursework followed by thesis research and an oral defense. To qualify, you must have a relevant 16 year degree with the required CGPA. For specific entry requirements, contact the Advanced Studies and Research Board.

instruction: how to know if i am eligible for bs ai program
output: You are eligible for BS Artificial Intelligence if you have completed F.Sc Pre-Engineering, ICS with Mathematics, or an equivalent qualification with at least 50% marks. If you have an F.Sc Pre-Medical background, you are also eligible, but you must pass deficiency Mathematics courses during your first year. Selection is based on your overall academic merit and entry test scores. To confirm specific eligibility rules, contact the Admissions Office.

instruction: can i switch my degree or shift after getting admission
output: You can't automatically switch your degree program or shift after confirming admission at NUML. Program transfers or shift changes from Evening to Morning are strictly related to seat availability, academic merit , and approvals. You must submit a formal application with details of your request to the Academics Branch during the transfer window. If you want to request a program or shift transfer, you should contact the Academics Branch directly.

instruction: what is the duration of associate programs at numl
output: The Associate Degree Program (ADP) at NUML is a two-year undergraduate qualification structured across four academic semesters. It provides practical technical skills in fields like computing and business. After completing an ADP with the required CGPA, you can apply for entry into the 5th semester of a similar 4-year BS degree program. To check transfer credit hours and other requirements, you should contact the relevant Department Head.

instruction: does numl offer english proficiency programs like ielts
output: Yes, NUML offers English language proficiency courses, including Functional English, Language Certificates, Diplomas, and IELTS preparation classes. These programs are managed by the Faculty of Languages to help you build oral fluency, grammar, and academic writing skills. Classes work on flexible schedules separate from regular degree course. To enroll or ask about batch timings, you should contact the Faculty of Languages office.

instruction: are degrees offered at regional campus same as main campus
output: Yes, degrees earned at NUML regional campuses has the exact same academic value and recognition as those from the main campus. All regional campuses follow identical course structure, exam patterns, and HEC guidelines. Your final degree certificate and transcript are issued directly by the NUML Main Campus in Islamabad without showing any campus difference. For regional campus offerings, contact the relevant Regional Campus Administration.

instruction: how many credit hours needed to complete to earn bs degree
output: You need to complete between 130 and 140 total credit hours to earn a standard four-year BS degree at NUML. These credits are distributed over eight academic semesters and include general subjects, core courses, practical lab sessions, and a project. You must also maintain the minimum required CGPA throughout your studies. For exact degree outline, you should check your department scheme of study.

instruction: what computing degrees are available other than bs cs
output: NUML offers several specialized computing degrees alongside Computer Science, including BS Software Engineering, BS Artificial Intelligence, BS Cyber Security, and BS Data Science. All four-year programs build core foundations in programming and mathematics before moving into advanced majors. Every computing degree is recognized under hec guidelines. To view course bs, contact the Faculty of Engineering and Computing.

instruction: can i apply for masters or mphil with previous degree of different prgram
output: Yes, you can apply for an MS or MPhil program in a different discipline, but you may need to complete bridging or deficiency courses first. The Departmental Graduate Committee reviews your background and assigns required undergraduate foundation courses, which you must pass during your initial semesters before starting master's level research. For discipline-switching rules, contact the Advanced Studies and Research Board.

instruction: does numl offer weekend classes for masters program
output: Yes, NUML offers executive degree options and postgraduate diplomas with flexible schedules, including late afternoon, evening, and weekend classes. These programs are specifically designed for working professionals who want to continue their education without interrupting their jobs. Course workloads, credit hours, and academic standards remain identical to regular morning programs. To confirm current weekend program availability, contact the Admissions Office.

instruction: are there diploma courses available in foreign languages
output: Yes, NUML offers diploma and certificate courses in numerous foreign languages, including Chinese, German, French, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, and Persian. You can progress from basic Certificate levels up to Advanced Diplomas. These programs cover grammar, speaking, and listening comprehension and are open to degree students and external learners. For language course schedules, contact the Faculty of Languages.

instruction: where to find complete outline or syllabus for my degree program
output: You can find course outlines and study schemes on the official NUML website under your specific degree program page. Detailed syllabi listing weekly topics, recommended textbooks, and grading policies are provided by your course instructors at the start of each semester. These materials are also uploaded to the NUML Learning Management System (LMS). If you need printed course roadmaps, contact your Department Coordinator.

instruction: does numl provide hostel accommodation on campus for both girls and boys
output: yes, NUML provides separate on-campus hostel facilities for both male and female students at its main campus. These hostels are intended to accommodate outstation students who move to Islamabad for their education. Because hostel capacity is limited, room allotment is not automatic and must be requested through an official application process. If you require on-campus accommodation, you should contact the Hostel Office.

instruction: how can a new admitted student aply for hostel at numl
output: You can apply for a hostel seat after confirming your academic admission at NUML. You need to obtain the hostel application form from the Hostel Office or download it from the student portal during the application window. Submit your completed form along with required identity documents, after which allotment lists are issued based on available space. To check application deadlines, contact the Hostel Office.

instruction: what is the criteria for getting into hostel at numl
output: Hostel seat at NUML prioritize outstation students from far regions, rural areas, and international candidates. Seats are assigned based on distance from your home town, academic level, and available quota limits across departments. Local residents of Rawalpindi and Islamabad can apply for hostel accommodation but it is based on priority. If you need details on selection criteria, you should contact the Hostel .

instruction: can students living in islamabad or pindi apply for hostel
output: yes, students residing within the local twin cities of Islamabad and Rawalpindi can apply for NUML hostel accommodation. but it os based on priority and subject to availability. Exceptions are rarely granted and require special administrative approval. If you have extreme circumstances, you must submit a formal appeal to the Warden Office.

instruction: what is the total hostel fees including security fees at numl
output: Hostel fees at NUML include per-semester room rent, utility fees, maintenance charges, and a one-time refundable security deposit. You must pay hostel charges using a university bank chalan separately from your academic tuition fees. Your security deposit is refunded when you complete your degree or formally vacate the hostel. For current fee amounts, you should contact the Finance Branch or Hostel Office.

instruction: is joining hostel mess necessary for every hostelite student
output: Yes, joining the official hostel mess facility is mandatory for all students living in NUML hostels. Cooking inside individual hostel rooms is strictly forbidden due to health and safety rules. The mess provides daily meals, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner, under a centralized system. By accepting a hostel room, you automatically agree to mess membership. For mess rules, contact the Hostel Warden Office.

instruction: how hostel mess bills calculated and when to pay them
output: Hostel mess charges are calculated on a monthly or per-semester cycle based on daily attendance and operational costs. Mess bills are posted on hostel notice boards, and you must clear your dues by the specified due date. Late payments can result in fines or temporary suspension of mess services. If you have questions about your bill, you should contact the Mess office.

instruction: what documents needed to submit to complete hostel requirements at numl
output: To confirm your hostel selection, you must submit attested copies of your CNIC or Form-B, guardian's CNIC, university admission fee voucher, recent photographs, and an affidavit agreeing to follow hostel regulations on the website. Foreign students must also provide valid passport and student visa copies. If you need the complete documentation list, contact the Hostel Administration Branch.

instruction: what are the entry and exit gate timings for hostels at numl
output: NUML enforces strict gate entry timings and evening curfews across all hostels, particularly girls' hostels, to ensure student safety. You must return to the hostel before the scheduled evening closing time unless you have prior written permission from the hostel warden. Attendance registers are checked daily. If you anticipate arriving late due to academic reasons, you must contact your Hostel Warden in advance.

instruction: what are the visiting hours for parents or family members at numl hostel
output: Parents and authorized family members can visit you inside hostel visitor lounges during fixed visiting hours. Visitors must present valid CNIC credentials and register at the security gate upon arrival. Unauthorized visitors and distant relatives are not allowed beyond reception areas. If your family plans to visit outside normal hours, you must request permission from the Hostel Warden.

instruction: are friends or guests allowed to stay in hostel at numl
output: No, external guests, friends, and day scholar classmates are strictly prohibited from staying overnight in your hostel room. Allowing unauthorized guests is a major violation of university hostel regulations. In case of emergency or visiting immediate family, temporary guest room accommodations may be requested through the Hostel Office subject to availability. For guest room bookings, contact the Warden Office.

instruction: what essentials and furnitures are provided are provided in each hostel room
output: Each hostel room at NUML comes with a single bed frame, study table, chair, and clothes cupboard. Standard fixtures like ceiling fans and lighting are provided in shared spaces. You must bring your own mattress, bedding, pillows, study lamps, and personal care items. If any room fixture requires repair after moveing in, you should contact the Hostel Maintenance Office.

instruction: is high speed internet or wifi provided in students hostel
output: Yes, NUML provides internet and Wi-Fi coverage across student hostels for academic and research purposes. You receive login credentials linked to your student ID after completing hostel enrollment. Internet access is accessed by agreeing to university usage policies. If you experience connection issues in your room, you should contact the IT Services Desk.

instruction: are there laundry machines and iron facilities available inside hostel
output: NUML hostels provide basic laundry spaces and washing areas for resident students to handle personal clothes. Additionally, laundry and pressing services nearby to offer affordable cleaning services. You are expected to keep shared washing areas clean and orderly. For information on local laundry service schedules, contact your Hostel Warden.

instruction: which electrical items or personal appliances are allowed in hostel rooms
output: You are only allowed to use small electrical devices such as laptop chargers, mobile phones, and study lamps inside your hostel room. Heavy electrical appliances including electric heaters, hot plates, irons, and microwave ovens , mini fridge are strictly forbidden to prevent electrical problems and power outages. If you have questions about specific electronic devices, contact the Hostel Management.

instruction: is hostel seat allocation based on academic marksor distance from home
output: Hostel seat allocation is evaluated using both your home district's distance from campus and your academic record. Priority is given to students traveling from remote provinces or foreign countries. For continuing semesters, maintaining a good CGPA and clean disciplinary record is required to renew your seat. To check your allotment ranking, contact the Hostel Allotment Board.

instruction: are evening shift students eligible to get hostel accommodation at numl
output: Morning shift degree students receive main priority for hostel accommodation due to limited seat capacity. Evening shift students are considered for hostel allotment only if spare rooms remain available after morning applicants are processed. If you are an evening student seeking a room, you should submit an application to the Hostel Office for special consideration.

instruction: what happens to my hostel seat if my attendance or performance drops
output: If your academic performance drops severely or your CGPA falls below university academic standing requirements, your hostel seat renewal may be canceled. Seats are re-evaluated each academic session, prioritizing active students in good academic standing. If you face academic difficulties affecting your stay, you should consult the Academics Branch and Hostel Office.

instruction: how do international students apply for numl hostel facilities
output: As an international student, you can apply for hostel accommodation through the International Students Office in coordination with the Hostel Branch. Reserved quota seats are allocated to foreign candidates upon arrival. You must submit your passport, student visa, and required security clearances during registration. For assistance with international stay, contact the International Students Office.

instruction: what medical or first aid facilities available near students hostel
output: Yes, basic medical care and first aid are available at the on-campus NUML Medical Center. Qualified medical staff assist students with basic health issues and emergency first response during operational hours. In cases of serious medical emergencies requiring hospitalization, hostel wardens coordinate transportation to nearby government hospitals. For medical assistance, contact your Hostel Warden immediately.

instruction: how do students apply for leave pass to go home on weekends from hostel
output: To go home for weekends or holidays, you must fill out a formal leave pass application at the Hostel Warden Office prior to leaving. You must state your destination, departure time, return date, and emergency contact details. Female students require parental or guardian consent before leave passes are approved. To request a pass, contact your Hostel Warden.

instruction: is it possible to request change of room or roommate during semester
output: Room allocations generally remain fixed for the full academic term. However, you can apply for a room or roommate change if you have valid academic or personal reasons. You must submit a written transfer application to the Hostel Warden for consideration. Room transfers depend entirely on available vacancies and warden approval. To submit a request, contact the Warden Office.

instruction: do students have to pack up and vacate their rooms during summer vacations
output: Yes, you are required to vacate your hostel room during summer breaks so the university can conduct deep cleaning and building maintenance. You must pack your belongings or store them in locker of the rooms. If you need to stay back for summer semester courses or research, you must apply for temporary vacation accommodation through the Hostel Office.

instruction: can i get a refund on my hostel fee if i leave the hostel early
output: If you leave the hostel early, your security deposit is refundable after clearing all mess dues. Room rent and semester charges are refunded depending on how early in the semester you formally cancel your seat. To initiate a refund request, you must contact the Finance Branch and Hostel Office.

instruction: whom to contact if i face maintenance or security issues at numl hostel
output: If you encounter maintenance problems like plumbing leaks or electrical faults, you should register your complaint in the maintenance register at the Warden Office. Assigned university technicians resolve complaints. For immediate safety or security concerns, you must report directly to your Hostel Warden or the campus security officer on duty.

instruction: how do i get a numl bus pass
output: You'll need to get a Bus Fee Challan from the Transport Office and deposit the required fee. Bus passes are then issued on a first-come, first-served basis, so it's worth applying early if you want a specific route, since seats can fill up quickly.

instruction: can i travel on numl bus without a pass
output: No, a valid Student Bus Pass is mandatory to travel on NUML's transport, and you won't be allowed to board without one. Make sure you've registered through the Transportal and received your pass before relying on the university bus for your daily commute. If you haven't applied yet, start the process through the Transport Office as early as possible, since passes are issued on a first-come, first-served basis.

instruction: where do i register for the numl bus
output: You register or renew your bus pass through the NUML Transportal, which is a separate portal from the main NUML website and the admission system. Make sure you check that portal directly rather than looking on the main university site.

instruction: when does bus registration open each semester
output: The NUML Transportal opens for a set registration window at the start of each semester, covering both renewal for continuing students and registration for new students. The exact dates are announced separately every semester, so check the Transportal itself rather than assuming last semester's dates apply.

instruction: im a new student when can i apply for a bus pass
output: New students are usually given a separate registration window on the NUML Transportal that opens slightly after the renewal window for continuing students. Keep checking the portal once you're formally admitted, since the exact opening and closing dates are announced fresh each semester rather than following a fixed calendar. Applying as soon as your window opens gives you a better chance of getting your preferred route, since passes are issued first-come, first-served.

instruction: can i pay my transport fee in installments
output: No, NUML's transport fee doesn't offer a fee waiver or installment option. You're expected to pay the full amount in one go when you deposit your Bus Fee Challan through the Transport Office. Budget for this as a single upfront payment each semester, and keep in mind that missing the announced payment deadline means you'll be struck off the transport list for that term with no further extension given.

instruction: im a special needs student how do i get a bus card
output: You can apply for a Special Person Bus Card through the Main Transport Officer (MTO) Office. You'll need to submit a simple application along with a copy of your Special CNIC or an equivalent certificate to confirm your eligibility. If you have questions about the process or documentation, you can also reach the Transport Office directly through NUML's main line for guidance before you submit.

instruction: what happens if i miss the transport fee deadline
output: If you don't deposit your Bus Fee by the announced deadline, you'll be struck off the transport list for that semester, and no further extension is given after the cutoff. Make sure you pay well within the window if you plan to use NUML's buses.

instruction: how will i know when my bus card is ready
output: You'll get an email notification once your bus card is ready for collection. From there, you can pick it up either from the bus on your assigned route or directly from the Transport Office, whichever is more convenient. Keep checking your registered email regularly during the processing period so you don't miss the notification and end up without your pass once classes start.

instruction: can i ride any numl bus route i want
output: No, your bus pass is only valid for the specific route it was issued for. You can't switch to a different route than the one shown on your pass, so make sure you register for the correct route from the start.

instruction: the registration window closed can i still get a bus seat
output: Possibly. If seats remain available on certain routes after the main registration window closes, the Transportal may reopen specifically for those vacant seats. You'd only be able to apply for the routes that still have space, so check back on the portal.

instruction: i applied early for transport is my seat confirmed
output: Not fully yet. If you applied early, you may be issued a conditional Bus Fee Challan as a head start, but this is provisional. Final approval of your bus pass only comes after any incorrect or missing information in your profile has been corrected.

instruction: i had a bus card last semester do i need to reapply
output: Yes, your bus card from a previous semester doesn't carry over automatically. You'll need to apply again for renewal through the NUML Transportal during the registration window and update your profile information for the current semester before a new pass is issued. Skipping this step means you won't be able to board university transport once the new term starts.

instruction: where do i get the transport application form
output: You can download the transport application form directly from the NUML Transport Portal, so you don't need to visit the Transport Office in person just to get it. Once you've filled it out, though, you may still need to submit it along with your Bus Fee Challan and any required documents in person or through the portal, depending on what's specified that semester.

instruction: who do i contact for transport issues
output: For transport-related queries, you can contact NUML's main line at +92-51-9265100, since transport matters are handled by the Transport Office under the main administration. This covers issues like registration problems, missing bus cards, route changes, or fee payment questions. Since the number connects to the university switchboard, you may need to ask to be transferred to the Transport Office specifically.

instruction: what is the hec need based scholarship for
output: It's a scholarship NUML offers in collaboration with the Higher Education Commission, aimed at supporting talented students who can't afford the cost of higher education on their own. Special preference is given to students coming from remote and rural areas, so if that describes your situation, it's worth applying.

instruction: who decides if i get the scholarship
output: Your application is reviewed by the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee (ISAC), which assesses your financial need before deciding on an award. There isn't a fixed formula you can calculate yourself - it comes down to the committee's evaluation of your submitted documents.

instruction: can graduate students apply for the need based scholarship too
output: Yes, the HEC Need Based Scholarship at NUML is available for both undergraduate (four-year) programs and graduate (two-year) programs, so you're not limited to just BS students. Eligibility is assessed the same way regardless of your degree level, based on demonstrated financial need, so graduate students should still prepare the same supporting documents when applying.

instruction: im at a regional campus can i still apply
output: Yes, students at NUML's regional campuses are also eligible to apply for the HEC Need Based Scholarship. You'd submit your application through your own campus rather than the main Islamabad campus, but make sure you meet the announced due date.

instruction: where do i submit my scholarship application
output: You submit your completed form along with all supporting documents to the Student Financial Aid Office, Room No. 26, Jinnah Block, at the NUML Islamabad campus. Make sure your document set is complete before submitting, since applications missing required paperwork or submitted after the due date aren't accepted, and double-check the announced deadline before you go.

instruction: what documents do i need for the need based scholarship
output: You'll need a paid fee challan copy, attested salary slips of a parent or supporting family member, a copy of the pension book if a parent is retired, recent utility bill copies, and two attested passport-size photographs. If you're beyond your first semester, you'll also need your previous semester's result transcript.

instruction: will my form be accepted if im missing a document
output: No, NUML doesn't accept Need Based Scholarship applications that are missing required supporting documents, or ones submitted after the announced due date. Make sure your document set - including your fee challan copy, salary slips, and photographs - is complete before you submit it to the Student Financial Aid Office, since incomplete forms are rejected outright rather than returned for correction.

instruction: how should i fill the scholarship form
output: Fill it out in black pen, complete every field carefully, and make sure the information you provide is factual, comprehensive, and authentic throughout. Incomplete or careless entries can affect how your application is assessed by the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee, so take your time and double-check everything against your supporting documents before you submit the form.

instruction: will i have an interview for the scholarship
output: If you're shortlisted after submitting a complete application, you'll be contacted separately for an interview as part of the selection process. Keep your contact details on the form accurate and check regularly for updates after submitting, since the Institutional Scholarship Award Committee typically reaches out by phone or email once shortlisting is finalized.

instruction: is there a scholarship based on grades instead of need
output: Yes, NUML also offers a separate Merit Scholarship awarded purely on academic excellence, regardless of financial need. It can come as a fee waiver, a fee refund, or a monetary award, so it's worth checking if you qualify based on your academic performance even if you don't meet the need-based criteria.

instruction: is there any other financial help besides the hec scholarship
output: Yes, NUML has a Support Fund specifically to help underprivileged and needy students, funded through voluntary donations and Zakat contributions from NUML employees. It's separate from the HEC Need Based Scholarship, so it's worth asking about if you don't qualify for that one.

instruction: what is the bait ul mal scholarship at numl
output: NUML also facilitates scholarships awarded by Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal (PBM) for deserving students. Applications for this are invited separately from the HEC Need Based Scholarship process, so check for its own announcement and deadline rather than assuming it follows the same schedule. Like other need-based options, it's worth applying to if the HEC scholarship doesn't work out for you.

instruction: who do i contact about scholarship questions

instruction: what does the need based scholarship cover
output: It's generally meant to cover your semester fee along with a monthly stipend toward living costs like books, transport, food, and hostel expenses. The exact amount depends on HEC's allocation for that cycle, so treat this as a general benefit rather than a fixed number, and confirm current details with the Student Financial Aid Office.

instruction: do i keep the scholarship automatically every semester
output: Not automatically. Scholarships like the Need Based Scholarship are meant for actively enrolled students, and continuing to receive it until you complete your degree generally depends on maintaining satisfactory academic performance each semester. If your results or enrollment status change, it's worth checking with the Student Financial Aid Office to confirm your scholarship status hasn't been affected.

instruction: how many faculties does numl have
output: NUML is organized into four faculties: Languages, Engineering and Computer Sciences, Management Studies, and Social Sciences. Depending on your program, you'll fall under one of these, which affects which dean's office and department handle your academic matters, approvals, and any program-specific queries you might have. If you're unsure which faculty your program belongs to, the Faculty Finder tool on the NUML website can point you to the right one.

instruction: what departments are under engineering and computer science
output: The Faculty of Engineering and Computer Sciences at NUML includes the Department of Electrical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science, and the Department of Mathematics. This faculty was established in October 2008, and its programs like BS Computer Science and BS Software Engineering are accredited by the National Computing Education Accreditation Council, while the electrical engineering degree is accredited separately by the Pakistan Engineering Council.

instruction: is bs computer science accredited at numl
output: Yes. NUML's BS Computer Science and BS Software Engineering programs are accredited by the National Computing Education Accreditation Council (NCEAC), and the BE Electrical Engineering degree is separately accredited by the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC). Both programs fall under the Faculty of Engineering and Computer Sciences, which also includes the Department of Mathematics, so accreditation applies across the department's core degrees.

instruction: when did cs start at numl
output: Computer Science classes began at NUML Islamabad in January 2002, and Engineering classes started later, in August 2006. Both programs now sit under the Faculty of Engineering and Computer Sciences, which was formally established in October 2008 to bring these growing departments together under one faculty structure, alongside the Department of Mathematics.

instruction: what programs does social sciences faculty offer
output: The Faculty of Social Sciences offers BS, MPhil, and PhD programs across areas like Educational Sciences, Applied Psychology, International Relations, Islamic Thought and Culture, Media and Communication Studies, Pakistan Studies, Peace and Conflict Studies, and Governance and Public Policy. It's one of NUML's four faculties, alongside Languages, Engineering and Computer Sciences, and Management Studies, so check with the relevant department for admission requirements.

instruction: is there an arts faculty at numl
output: Yes, NUML has a Faculty of Arts and Humanities, which focuses on nurturing students' aesthetic abilities alongside their regular academic work. It complements NUML's other four core faculties - Languages, Engineering and Computer Sciences, Management Studies, and Social Sciences - by giving students a space to develop creative and artistic skills alongside their main degree program.

instruction: how do i contact the engineering faculty
output: You can reach the Dean of the Faculty of Engineering and Computer Sciences through NUML's main line, +92-51-9265100, extension 2060, or by emailing dean-engg@numl.edu.pk. If your query is program-specific rather than about the faculty as a whole, it may be faster to contact your department directly, or use the Faculty Finder tool on the NUML website to find the right contact.

instruction: how do i find the right department to contact
output: NUML offers a Faculty Finder tool on its website to help you identify and reach the correct department or faculty contact for whatever you need help with. This is especially useful if you're not sure which of NUML's four faculties your program falls under, since each faculty and department has its own dean's office and contact details.

instruction: what subjects can i study at numl overall
output: Across its faculties, NUML offers programs in languages and linguistics, social sciences, media and communications, management sciences, and electrical/software engineering and computer sciences, at undergraduate, graduate, and postgraduate levels. These are organized under four main faculties plus the Faculty of Arts and Humanities, so use the Faculty Finder tool if you're unsure which one covers your intended program.

instruction: what is numls motto
output: NUML's official motto is "We teach how to think, not what to think," reflecting its focus on critical thinking rather than rote learning. This philosophy is meant to run across all of its faculties and programs, from languages and social sciences to engineering and management, encouraging students to reason independently rather than simply memorize material.

instruction: where exactly is numl islamabad located
output: NUML's main campus is located in Sector H-9, Islamabad, and is the university's primary campus alongside its regional campuses spread across the country in cities like Lahore, Faisalabad, and Karachi, among others. If you're coming from outside Islamabad, it's worth checking whether your program is also offered at a closer regional campus before you commit to the main one.

instruction: does numl have other campuses
output: Yes, besides the main Islamabad campus, NUML has regional campuses in Lahore, Faisalabad, Karachi, Multan, Quetta, Peshawar, Hyderabad, Gwadar, Rawalpindi, and Mirpur AJK. Program availability and admission requirements can vary by campus, so if you're considering a regional campus, check directly with that campus rather than assuming it mirrors the Islamabad main campus exactly.

instruction: what is the main library called
output: The central library at NUML Islamabad is called the Sir Syed Library, and it serves as the main academic resource hub for students across all faculties on the main campus. It's located within the H-9 campus, alongside other student facilities like the cafeterias, auditorium, and hostel blocks, making it one of the more central buildings on campus.

instruction: is there food available on campus
output: Yes, NUML's Islamabad campus has two cafeterias offering healthy and affordable food choices for students, including vegetarian options. They're a convenient option for students spending long hours on campus between classes, and are part of the broader set of campus facilities that also includes the Sir Syed Library, auditorium, and sports grounds.

instruction: does numl have an auditorium
output: Yes, NUML has a large auditorium used for events like Convocation, conferences, and open house job fairs. It's one of the main venues on the Islamabad campus for university-wide gatherings, and is also used for guest lectures and seminars hosted by different faculties throughout the academic year.

instruction: is there a mosque on campus
output: Yes, there's a community mosque in the heart of the NUML Islamabad campus, open 24 hours a day for daily prayers. It's accessible to all students and staff regardless of which faculty or hostel they belong to, and is one of the core facilities available on the main H-9 campus alongside the library and cafeterias.

instruction: are numl hostels safe
output: Yes, NUML has separate, fully furnished hostel facilities for boys and girls, built with safety and comfort in mind, and maintained with round-the-clock security. Each hostel is self-contained with its own reading room, indoor games room, lounge, and dining hall, so residents don't need to leave the building for most daily needs.

instruction: what facilities are inside the hostel rooms
output: Each hostel at NUML - separate for boys, girls, and faculty - is self-contained with a reading room, an indoor games room, a lounge, and a dining hall with mess facilities. On top of these shared spaces, the Girls' Hostel also has table tennis and an outdoor badminton court, while the Boys' Hostel includes basketball and badminton courts for residents.

instruction: what sports facilities does numl have
output: NUML has a modern gymnasium with basketball, handball, volleyball, and badminton courts, table tennis, and weight training equipment, plus outdoor grounds for cricket, football, hockey, and two additional basketball courts. These facilities are open to students across all faculties, and some are also accessible from within the hostel blocks for residents living on campus.

instruction: can i play sports inside the hostel
output: Yes, the Girls' Hostel has a table tennis and outdoor badminton court, while the Boys' Hostel has basketball and badminton courts. These are on top of the university's main gymnasium and outdoor grounds, so hostel residents have sports options both within their own hostel and across the wider Islamabad campus.

instruction: does numl have video conferencing
output: Yes, NUML has a video conference facility that's regularly used to conduct or relay conferences, seminars, and workshops held on the Islamabad campus. It's typically used alongside the university's auditorium for larger academic and administrative events, allowing sessions to be relayed to participants who can't attend in person.

instruction: is there mental health support at numl
output: Yes, NUML operates a Psychological Counselling Center on campus for students who need support. It's available to students across all faculties on the Islamabad campus, offering a space to talk through academic stress, personal difficulties, or anything else affecting your wellbeing during your time at the university.

instruction: does numl have a radio station
output: Yes, NUML runs its own student-operated FM radio station, NUML Radio, which serves as a training platform for media and communication students. It gives students hands-on broadcasting experience alongside their coursework, and is one of several practical, extracurricular facilities available on the Islamabad campus outside the regular classroom.

instruction: when did numl become a university
output: NUML started out as the Institute of Modern Languages in 1969 and was upgraded to a federally chartered university in May 2000. Since then it has grown from a language-focused institute into a multi-faculty university, now covering languages, engineering and computer sciences, management studies, social sciences, and arts and humanities.

instruction: how do i apply for a hostel seat
output: Hostel accommodation at NUML's Main Campus is limited, so you'll want to apply early. You can collect the hostel application form from the office of the Director of Students Affairs, but only after you've submitted your semester or course fee.
